title: Pumpkin Candle
description: Gain 1 energy at the start of each turn. Extinguishes after 5 combats. Can be Kindled at Rest Sites.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Starts with 5 uses when obtained. Each combat consumes 1 use. When all uses are expended, the relic becomes disabled. The Kindle option at Rest Sites restores 5 uses.
